verses.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלְכ֛וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָה֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rê·šîṯ mam·lə·ḵūṯ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh hā·yāh had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: At the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah this . . . word came from the LORD
verses.literalPt: No princípio do reinado de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, veio da parte de Jeová esta palavra, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲמֹד֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֒ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֞ עַל־ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה הַבָּאִים֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖יךָ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אַל־ תִּגְרַ֖ע דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘ă·mōḏ ba·ḥă·ṣar bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḏib·bar·tā ‘al- kāl- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh hab·bā·’îm lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā lə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem ’al- tiḡ·ra‘ dā·ḇār
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and speak . . . all the words I have commanded you to speak to all the cities of Judah who come to worship there . . . Do not omit a word
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Põe-te no átrio da Casa de Jeová e fala a todas as cidades de Judá, que vêm a adorar na Casa de Jeová, todas as palavras que eu te mandar que lhes fales; não omitas uma só palavra.

verses.original: אוּלַ֣י יִשְׁמְע֔וּ וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה וְנִחַמְתִּ֣י אֶל־ הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י חֹשֵׁב֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yiš·mə·‘ū wə·yā·šu·ḇū ’îš mid·dar·kōw hā·rā·‘āh wə·ni·ḥam·tî ’el- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥō·šêḇ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·hem mip·pə·nê rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: Perhaps they will listen and turn each from his evil way of life so that I may relent of the disaster I am planning to bring upon them because of the evil of their deeds
verses.literalPt: Pode ser que ouçam e se convertam, cada um do seu mau caminho, para que eu me arrependa do mal que intento fazer-lhes por causa da maldade dos seus feitos.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lay lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: And you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says If you do not listen to Me and walk in My law which I have set before you
verses.literalPt: Dir-lhes-ás: Assim diz Jeová: Se não me ouvirdes, para andardes na minha lei, que pus diante de vós,

verses.original: לִשְׁמֹ֗עַ עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֨י עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: liš·mō·a‘ ‘al- diḇ·rê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay han·nə·ḇi·’îm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·lê·aḥ ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·haš·kêm wə·šā·lō·aḥ wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem
verses.literal: and if you do not listen to the words of My servants the prophets whom I have sent you again and again even though you did not listen
verses.literalPt: e para ouvirdes as palavras dos meus servos, os profetas, que eu vos envio, levantando-me cedo e enviando-os (porém vós não tendes escutado),

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י אֶת־ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה כְּשִׁלֹ֑ה וְאֶת־ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאתָה אֶתֵּ֣ן לִקְלָלָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh kə·ši·lōh wə·’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zō·ṯå̄h ’et·tên liq·lā·lāh lə·ḵōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: then I will make this house like Shiloh and I will make this city an object of cursing among all the nations of the earth
verses.literalPt: farei que esta casa seja como Siló e farei desta cidade uma maldição para todas as nações da terra.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֛וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַנְּבִאִ֖ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֑ם אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·han·nə·ḇi·’îm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū mə·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now the priests and prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Os sacerdotes, os profetas e todo o povo ouviram a Jeremias, proferindo estas palavras na Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לְדַבֵּר֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיִּתְפְּשׂ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַנְּבִאִ֛ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֥ם לֵאמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·wṯ yir·mə·yā·hū lə·ḏab·bêr ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām way·yiṯ·pə·śū ’ō·ṯōw hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·han·nə·ḇi·’îm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām lê·mōr mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ
verses.literal: and as soon as he had finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded him to say the priests and prophets and all the people seized him shouting You must surely die . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jeremias acabado de falar tudo o que Jeová lhe ordenara que falasse a todo o povo, pegaram nele os sacerdotes, e os profetas, e todo o povo, dizendo: Certamente, morrerás.

verses.original: מַדּוּעַ֩ נִבֵּ֨יתָ בְשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר כְּשִׁלוֹ֙ יִֽהְיֶה֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה וְהָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את תֶּחֱרַ֖ב מֵאֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֑ב וַיִּקָּהֵ֧ל כָּל־ הָעָ֛ם אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ nib·bê·ṯā ḇə·šêm- Yah·weh lê·mōr kə·ši·lōw yih·yeh hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh wə·hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ te·ḥĕ·raḇ mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ way·yiq·qā·hêl kāl- hā·‘ām ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: How dare you prophesy in the name of the LORD that this house will become like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted And all the people assembled against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porque profetizaste em nome de Jeová, dizendo: Esta casa será como Siló, e esta cidade ficará erma e desabitada. Todo o povo se ajuntou a Jeremias, na Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ׀ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיַּעֲל֥וּ מִבֵּית־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בְּפֶ֥תַח שַֽׁעַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֶחָדָֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ’êṯ had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·ya·‘ă·lū mib·bêṯ- ham·me·leḵ bêṯ Yah·weh way·yê·šə·ḇū bə·p̄e·ṯaḥ ša·‘ar- Yah·weh he·ḥā·ḏāš
verses.literal: When the officials of Judah heard these things they went up from the king’s palace to the house of the LORD and sat there at the entrance of the New Gate
verses.literalPt: Quando os príncipes de Judá ouviram essas coisas, subiram da casa do rei à Casa de Jeová e se assentaram à entrada da Porta Nova da Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהַנְּבִאִים֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֙וֶת֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י נִבָּא֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·han·nə·ḇi·’îm ’el- haś·śā·rîm wə·’el- kāl- hā·‘ām lê·mōr miš·paṭ- mā·weṯ lā·’îš haz·zeh kî nib·bā ’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ka·’ă·šer šə·ma‘·tem bə·’ā·zə·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then the priests and prophets said to the officials and all the people . . . This man is worthy of death for he has prophesied against this city as you have heard with your own ears
verses.literalPt: Disseram os sacerdotes e os profetas aos príncipes e a todo o povo: Este homem é réu de morte, porque profetizou contra esta cidade, como ouvistes com os vossos próprios ouvidos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֗נִי לְהִנָּבֵ֞א אֶל־ הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- kāl- haś·śā·rîm wə·’el- kāl- hā·‘ām lê·mōr Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî lə·hin·nā·ḇê ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh wə·’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šə·ma‘·tem
verses.literal: But Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people . . . The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard
verses.literalPt: Jeremias falou a todos os príncipes e a todo o povo: Jeová enviou-me a profetizar contra esta casa e contra esta cidade todas as palavras que ouvistes.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֵיטִ֤יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶם֙ וּמַ֣עַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשִׁמְע֕וּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְיִנָּחֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hê·ṭî·ḇū ḏar·ḵê·ḵem ū·ma·‘al·lê·ḵem wə·šim·‘ū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·yin·nā·ḥêm Yah·weh ’el- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer dib·ber ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: So now correct your ways and deeds and obey the voice of the LORD your God so that He might relent of the disaster He has pronounced against you
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, emendai os vossos caminhos e os vossos feitos e obedecei a voz de Jeová, vosso Deus, e Jeová se arrependerá do mal que falou contra vós.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֖י הִנְנִ֣י בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם עֲשׂוּ־ לִ֛י כַּטּ֥וֹב וְכַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nî ḇə·yeḏ·ḵem ‘ă·śū- lî kaṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·ḵay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: As for me here I am in your hands do to me what you think is good and right
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto a mim, eis que estou nas vossas mãos; fazei a mim conforme for bom e reto aos vossos olhos.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אִם־ מְמִתִ֣ים אַתֶּם֮ אֹתִי֒ כִּי־ דָ֣ם נָקִ֗י אַתֶּם֙ נֹתְנִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶל־ יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י בֶאֱמֶ֗ת שְׁלָחַ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּר֙ בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏə·‘ū kî ’im- mə·mi·ṯîm ’at·tem ’ō·ṯî kî- ḏām nā·qî ’at·tem nō·ṯə·nîm ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·’el- yō·šə·ḇe·hā kî ḇe·’ĕ·meṯ šə·lā·ḥa·nî Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·ḏab·bêr bə·’ā·zə·nê·ḵem ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: But know for certain . . . that if you put me to death you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves upon this city and upon its residents for truly the LORD has sent me to speak all these words in your hearing
verses.literalPt: Tão somente ficai sabendo que, se vós me tirardes a vida, trareis sangue inocente sobre vós mesmos, sobre esta cidade e sobre os seus habitantes; porque, na verdade, Jeová me enviou a vós a falar aos vossos ouvidos todas essas palavras.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאֶל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים אֵין־ לָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֔וֶת כִּ֗י בְּשֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū haś·śā·rîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·’el- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ên- lā·’îš haz·zeh miš·paṭ- mā·weṯ kî bə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū dib·ber ’ê·lê·nū
verses.literal: Then the officials and all the people told the priests . . . and prophets This man is not worthy of death for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Disseram os príncipes e todo o povo aos sacerdotes e aos profetas: Este homem não é réu de morte, pois em nome de Jeová, nosso Deus, nos falou.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִזִּקְנֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל־ כָּל־ קְהַ֥ל הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū ’ă·nā·šîm miz·ziq·nê hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·mə·rū ’el- kāl- qə·hal hā·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: Some of the elders of the land stood up . . . and said to the whole assembly of the people . . .
verses.literalPt: Levantaram-se alguns dos anciãos da terra e falaram a toda a assembleia do povo:

verses.original: מִיכָיָה הַמּ֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י הָיָ֣ה נִבָּ֔א בִּימֵ֖י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ כָּל־ עַם֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה לֵאמֹ֜ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵֽחָרֵשׁ֙ וִירוּשָׁלַ֙יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: mī·ḵå̄·yå̄h ham·mō·w·raš·tî hā·yāh nib·bā bî·mê ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer ’el- kāl- ‘am yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ṣî·yō·wn śā·ḏeh ṯê·ḥā·rêš wî·rū·šā·la·yim ‘î·yîm tih·yeh wə·har hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḇā·mō·wṯ yā·‘ar
verses.literal: Micah the Moreshite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and told . . . all the people of Judah that this is what . . . the LORD of Hosts says Zion will be plowed like a field Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble and the temple mount a wooded ridge
verses.literalPt: Miqueias, o morastita, profetizou nos dias de Ezequias, rei de Judá; e falou a todo o povo de Judá: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos: Sião será lavrada como um campo, e Jerusalém se tornará em montões, e o monte da Casa, em altos cobertos de bosque.

verses.original: הֶהָמֵ֣ת הֱ֠מִתֻהוּ חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה הֲלֹא֮ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־ יְהוָה֒ וַיְחַל֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים רָעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: he·hā·mêṯ hĕ·mi·ṯu·hū ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh hă·lō yā·rê ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·ḥal ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh way·yin·nā·ḥem Yah·weh ’el- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- dib·ber ‘ă·lê·hem wa·’ă·naḥ·nū ‘ō·śîm rā·‘āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh ‘al- nap̄·šō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death . . . Did Hezekiah not fear the LORD and seek His favor and did not the LORD relent of the disaster He had pronounced against them But we are about to bring great harm on ourselves
verses.literalPt: Porventura, lhe tiraram a vida Ezequias, rei de Judá, e todo o Judá? Acaso, não temeu o rei a Jeová, e não se arrependeu Jeová do mal que falara contra eles? Mas nós estamos fazendo um grande mal contra as nossas almas.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֤ה מִתְנַבֵּא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֽוּרִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־ שְׁמַעְיָ֔הוּ מִקִּרְיַ֖ת הַיְּעָרִ֑ים וַיִּנָּבֵ֞א עַל־ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את כְּכֹ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’îš hā·yāh miṯ·nab·bê bə·šêm Yah·weh ’ū·rî·yā·hū ben- šə·ma‘·yā·hū miq·qir·yaṯ hay·yə·‘ā·rîm way·yin·nā·ḇê ‘al- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ kə·ḵōl diḇ·rê yir·mə·yā·hū
verses.literal: Now there was another man . . . prophesying in the name of the LORD Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim He prophesied against this city and against this land the same things . . . that Jeremiah did
verses.literalPt: Houve também um homem, Urias, filho de Semaías, de Quiriate-Jearim, que profetizava em nome de Jeová; e profetizou contra esta cidade e contra esta terra segundo todas as palavras de Jeremias.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ יְ֠הוֹיָקִים וְכָל־ גִּבּוֹרָ֤יו וְכָל־ הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרָ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֥שׁ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הֲמִית֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אוּרִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וַיִּרָ֔א וַיִּבְרַ֖ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ham·me·leḵ- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm wə·ḵāl gib·bō·w·rāw wə·ḵāl haś·śā·rîm ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rāw way·ḇaq·qêš ham·me·leḵ hă·mî·ṯōw way·yiš·ma‘ ’ū·rî·yā·hū way·yi·rā way·yiḇ·raḥ way·yā·ḇō miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: King Jehoiakim and all his mighty men and officials heard his words and the king sought to put him to death But when Uriah found out about it he fled in fear and went to Egypt
verses.literalPt: Quando o rei Jeoaquim, e todos os seus principais homens, e todos os príncipes ouviram as palavras dele, procurou o rei tirar-lhe a vida; mas, quando Urias o ouviu, temeu, fugiu e foi para o Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֛ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יִם אֵ֣ת אֶלְנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּ֛וֹר וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ’ă·nā·šîm miṣ·rā·yim ’êṯ ’el·nā·ṯān ben- ‘aḵ·bō·wr wa·’ă·nā·šîm ’it·tōw ’el- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt Elnathan son of Achbor along with . . . some other men
verses.literalPt: Enviou o rei Jeoaquim certos homens ao Egito; enviou ao Egito Elnatã, filho de Acbor, e outros homens com ele,

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ אוּרִיָּ֜הוּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וַיְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֖הוּ בֶּחָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָת֔וֹ אֶל־ קִבְרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- ’ū·rî·yā·hū mim·miṣ·ra·yim way·ḇi·’u·hū ’el- ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm way·yak·kê·hū be·ḥā·reḇ way·yaš·lêḵ ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯōw ’el- qiḇ·rê bə·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim who had him put to the sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people
verses.literalPt: os quais tiraram do Egito a Urias e o trouxeram ao rei Jeoaquim; este o fez morrer à espada e lançou o seu cadáver nas sepulturas da plebe.

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ יַ֚ד אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֔ן הָיְתָ֖ה אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ לְבִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת־ אֹת֥וֹ בְיַד־ הָעָ֖ם לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ yaḏ ’ă·ḥî·qām ben- šā·p̄ān hā·yə·ṯāh ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū lə·ḇil·tî têṯ- ’ō·ṯōw ḇə·yaḏ- hā·‘ām la·hă·mî·ṯōw
verses.literal: Nevertheless Ahikam son of Shaphan supported . . . . . . Jeremiah so he was not handed over to - the people to be put to death
verses.literalPt: Porém a mão de Aicão, filho de Safã, foi com Jeremias, de modo que não foi entregue nas mãos do povo, para que o matasse.
